result.title: SignAligner: Dual-Granularity Span Generation for Sign Language Alignment
result.summary: Large sign-language corpora benefit from temporal labels at two scales: subtitle spans for subtitle alignment and word spans for sign spotting. Sign spottings already locate words in time at corpus scale, but training subtitle alignment jointly on subtitle and word spans remains underexplored. We present SignAligner, a prompt-conditioned visual-language span generator that maps a sign-language video and a subtitle-sentence or target-word query to a textual start/end frame interval. It is first trained jointly on subtitle spans and word spans from sign spottings, then refined with overlap-based rewards while retaining auxiliary word examples. On the subtitle test set of the British Broadcasting Corporation-Oxford British Sign Language (BOBSL) corpus, the refined model reaches 66.68 F1@0.50 (F1 with a temporal intersection-over-union threshold of one half), the best among compared systems without external sign-video resources. This overlap-reward refinement outperforms cross-entropy continuation from the same jointly trained model. Joint training with word spans improves subtitle alignment in a pair of our generators matched in code, labels and maximum update budget. The advantage remains after both models of the pair are refined with overlap rewards. For word queries, the refined model follows the queried word, not a fixed position in the video: when the word's sign lies away from the video centre, it is far more accurate than predictions that use position alone. Together, these findings support one shared span generator refined with overlap rewards, aligning subtitles and producing word spans for human review.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SignAligner，一个由提示条件驱动的视觉-语言 span 生成器，输入手语视频与字幕句或目标词查询，输出起止帧区间；先联合字幕 span 与词 span 训练，再用基于重叠度的奖励微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用时序重叠奖励替代交叉熵继续训练区间预测，可能为 LVR 中证据定位与停止决策的监督、奖励设计提供可核查线索，但任务本身是手语视频时间定位，与 latent 推理状态无直接联系。
